Use SPEC-NN numbering as the spec template requires, EARS acceptance criteria (AC-N), and a `Status: draft` line at the top.

The decisions below are final. Do not ask clarifying questions and do not leave any [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers; draft directly.

Decisions:
- `POST /notes/:id/archive` sets `archivedAt` (ISO timestamp) on the note and returns 200 with the note; 404 for an unknown id; archiving an already-archived note is a no-op that returns 200 with the unchanged note.
- `GET /notes` hides archived notes; `GET /notes?archived=true` returns only archived notes.
- `GET /notes/:id` still returns an archived note.
- No unarchive. No new dependencies. Tests go in `test/` using node:test and node:assert/strict.
